name: Tenant analytics isolation
verification: Tenant A cannot query, export, benchmark-identify or AI-retrieve Tenant B protected analytics.

name: Row security
verification: Row-level restrictions persist through semantic queries, dashboards, reports and exports.

name: Column security
verification: Restricted fields are hidden/masked according to policy.

name: Warehouse service identity
verification: Pipelines use scoped service identities and managed credentials.

name: Lake/object security
verification: Analytical object zones enforce encryption, tenant/purpose access and lifecycle controls.

name: Export auditing
verification: Privileged/large/sensitive exports are audited and policy controlled.

name: Query audit
verification: Sensitive semantic/ad-hoc queries retain actor, tenant and accessed asset metadata.

name: Privacy deletion
verification: Approved deletion requests propagate to governed analytical stores or documented exceptions.

name: Feature/embedding security
verification: AI feature/embedding access cannot exceed source-record permissions/classification.

name: Pipeline code security
verification: ETL/ELT code and dependencies pass secure SDLC gates.

name: Credential separation
verification: Analytics credentials are separated by environment and privilege.

name: Metadata protection
verification: Catalog/lineage must not expose restricted field names/content beyond permissions.

name: Benchmark privacy
verification: Cross-tenant benchmark outputs satisfy minimum aggregation/privacy policy.

name: Subscription delivery
verification: Scheduled report destinations/recipients are validated and permission checked.

name: Report parameter security
verification: Report parameters cannot bypass row/tenant/column policy.

name: Audit integrity
verification: Analytics audit and certification evidence is protected from ordinary mutation.
